jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

jobs.description:
About AssetBridge

Asset Bridge empowers Registered Investment Advisors(RIA) and family offices to seamlessly manage digital assets with integrations across leading crypto custodians, a built-in CRM for client onboarding, and access to DeFi investment opportunities like liquid staking and lending. With automated reporting for compliance and audits, we simplify operations, enhance investment flexibility, and ensure regulatory peace of mind—all in one intuitive platform.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Software Engineer with Web3 experience to join our team remotely. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with modern backend and frontend technologies, a strong understanding of blockchain systems, and a passion for building reliable and scalable software solutions.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using Python, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres, and AWS.

  • Integrate and interact with blockchain networks and decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols using web3 libraries.

  • Collaborate on backend services that communicate with staking platforms and other smart contract-based systems.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions and participate in code reviews to maintain high standards of quality and performance.

  • Requirements:

  • Proven experience with our core tech stack: Python, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres, and AWS.

  • Strong understanding of blockchain concepts and practical experience in the blockchain domain.

  • Proficient in working with web3 libraries to interact with DeFi and staking protocols.

  • Familiarity with Solidity and smart contract development, though extensive experience writing new contracts is not required.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Why Join Us?

  • Exciting fintech startup solving real-world problems for investment advisors.

  • Fully remote role with flexible working hours.

  • Opportunity to work closely with the founders and make a direct impact.
